channel.title: Sample zodiac feed (for offline runs and tests)

item.title: Weekly love horoscope
item.description: Aries, a magnetic attraction sparks when you least expect it; say yes to the date. Leo, romance and chemistry light up your week. Libra feels a sweet, tender connection with someone new. Scorpio meets delays and tension in love, so take it slow. Capricorn, an ex resurfaces with drama.

item.title: Gemini season of the heart
item.description: Gemini, flirty conversations turn into real passion. Aquarius may feel lonely, but it passes.
